name: [CONSOLE] Blind Tag
desc:
Hiders are fully invisible and must survive while seekers hunt them down. Every 10 seconds, hiders are revealed for 5 seconds 👀 that’s your moment.

Use crazy potions and tools 🧪 like speed, vision, jump boosts to outplay everyone. Grind for coins, XP, levels, spins 💰🎡 unlock rewards and climb the leader boards 🏆

Fast rounds 🔥 high skill 😈 nonstop action 💥
Hide smart… or hunt better.
